messages.relationshipStubsDisabled: Create or update children through their journey, stage or record fields, not relationship ID lists.
messages.cannotChangeRecord: A parent link cannot be moved to another journey record.
messages.linkJourneyMismatch: The link must belong to the record's journey.
messages.selfParent: A journey record cannot be its own parent.
messages.duplicateParent: This related record is already linked to the journey record.
messages.cannotReparent: A stage or record cannot be reassigned to another journey.
messages.journeyRequired: Select an existing journey with an owning tenant.
messages.tenantMismatch: The tenant must match the journey tenant.
messages.notAccessible: The selected record is not accessible.
messages.teamsRequired: Select teams belonging to one tenant.
messages.teamsMismatch: Every journey team must belong to the same tenant.
messages.cannotChangeTenant: A journey cannot be moved to another tenant.
messages.stageMismatch: The selected stage must belong to the selected journey.
messages.inactiveEntry: Records can only enter active journeys and stages.
messages.invalidStatus: Status must be On Hold, To Do, Doing or Done.
messages.targetTenantMismatch: The related record must belong to the journey tenant.
messages.assigneeTenantMismatch: The assigned user must belong to the journey tenant.
messages.journeyInUse: This journey has stages or records. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
messages.stageInUse: This stage has records. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
messages.useRecordFields: Update the record fields instead of linking or unlinking this relationship.
